info.name: worker-service
info.description: Rusuh Booking Tiket — Worker Service (port 8084). Kafka consumer only — tidak ada HTTP endpoint business logic.

request.description: Cek apakah worker-service hidup. Worker tidak expose HTTP endpoint untuk business logic — semua dikonsumsi via Kafka.

item.name: Kafka Topics (Dokumentasi)
item.description: Worker-service adalah pure Kafka consumer. Tidak ada endpoint HTTP untuk trigger email. Folder ini hanya referensi topic dan payload yang di-consume.

request.description:
Topic: booking.created
Triggered by: booking-service setelah POST /api/v1/bookings berhasil.

Payload:
{
  "bookingId": "uuid",
  "eventId": "EVT-001",
  "email": "budi@example.com",
  "paymentExpiresAt": "2026-10-23T14:00:00Z",
  "items": [
    {
      "categoryId": "CAT-VIP",
      "ticketCode": "TKT-VIP-001",
      "nik": "3273010101900001",
      "price": 500000
    }
  ]
}

Aksi worker: kirim email HTML #1 'Instruksi Pembayaran' ke email.

Topic: payment.succeeded
Triggered by: payment-service setelah Midtrans callback settlement.

Payload:
{
  "paymentId": "uuid",
  "bookingId": "uuid",
  "eventId": "EVT-001",
  "email": "budi@example.com",
  "method": "qris",
  "items": [
    {
      "categoryId": "CAT-VIP",
      "ticketCode": "TKT-VIP-001",
      "nik": "3273010101900001",
      "nama": "Budi Santoso",
      "price": 500000
    }
  ]
}

Aksi worker: kirim email HTML #2 'E-Tiket Boarding Pass' ke email.
Idempotency: 1 email per bookingId.

Topic: payment.expired
Triggered by: payment-service TTL sweeper atau Midtrans callback expire/cancel.

Payload:
{
  "bookingId": "uuid",
  "eventId": "EVT-001",
  "email": "budi@example.com",
  "reason": "PAYMENT_TTL"
}

Aksi worker: kirim email HTML #3 'Booking Dibatalkan' ke email.

Retry: gagal -> .retry topic (max 3x, backoff 5s/10s/20s) -> .dlt
